```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

source("_common.R")

global_stats <- read_csv_safe(file.path("csv", "global_stats.csv"))
global_rrmse_comparison <- read_csv_safe(
  file.path("csv", "global_rrmse_comparison.csv")
)
```

## Degraded variables

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
if (is.null(global_rrmse_comparison)) {
  cat("::: {.callout-note}\nNo comparison done.\n:::\n\n")
} else {
  # `status` already accounts for the minimum number of observations
  # (variables without enough of them are "Not tested").
  by_status <- split(
    global_rrmse_comparison$variable, global_rrmse_comparison$status
  )
  cat(sprintf(
    "<p><strong>%d variable(s) critical</strong> (major rRMSE increase)<br>\n%s</p>\n", # nolint: line_length_linter
    length(by_status[["Critical"]]),
    tag_list(by_status[["Critical"]], "Critical")
  ))
  cat(sprintf(
    "<p><strong>%d variable(s) warning</strong> (minor rRMSE increase)<br>\n%s</p>\n", # nolint: line_length_linter
    length(by_status[["Warning"]]),
    tag_list(by_status[["Warning"]], "Warning")
  ))
  cat(sprintf(
    "<p><strong>%d variable(s) improved</strong> (rRMSE stable or improved)<br>\n%s</p>\n", # nolint: line_length_linter
    length(by_status[["Improved"]]),
    tag_list(by_status[["Improved"]], "Improved")
  ))
  if (length(by_status[["Not tested"]]) > 0) {
    cat(sprintf(
      "<p><strong>%d variable(s) not tested</strong> (fewer than 10 observations)<br>\n%s</p>\n", # nolint: line_length_linter
      length(by_status[["Not tested"]]),
      tag_list(by_status[["Not tested"]], "Not tested")
    ))
    cat(paste0(
      "::: {.callout-note}\n",
      "A variable is only tested if it has at least 10 observations ",
      "(`n_obs >= 10`) over all the evaluated USMs.\n",
      ":::\n\n"
    ))
  }
}

comparison_path <- file.path("plots", "global_comparison.png")
if (file.exists(comparison_path)) {
  cat("### Comparison plot\n\n")
  cat(sprintf(
    '<img src="%s" style="max-width:100%%; border:1px solid #ddd;">\n\n', # nolint: line_length_linter
    comparison_path
  ))
}
```
